lines.text: Agents shouldn't disappear behind terminals. One cockpit. Every agent.
T3 Code stays visible. Hermes stays powerful. The bridge connects them in both directions.
T3 to Hermes. Hermes to T3. And any thread can call at Hermes—and keep the conversation going.
Fourteen tests. Three live flows. Zero forks. Two independent reviews. Every finding fixed before release.
Founder idea. Hermes and Orbit orchestrated. Codex executed. Public proof. Try it. Break it. Contribute.
